# Agentic Lakehouse

> AgenticLakehouse.com is a reference on the agentic lakehouse: data lakehouse architectures built for autonomous AI agents, combining Apache Iceberg open table formats, semantic layers, fine-grained governance (RBAC/ABAC), and high-performance query execution for agentic analytics and BI workflows. Written for data engineers and architects by Alex Merced, Head of Developer Relations at Dremio.

## About

- [Agentic Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/): Build the agentic lakehouse: reference architecture, working patterns, and a community of builders.
- [Agentic Lakehouse Glossary](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/): 200 agentic lakehouse terms for engineers and architects.
- [Agentic Lakehouse community on Luma](https://luma.com/agenticlakehouse): Events and meetups for people building agents on lakehouse data.
- [Video Explainers](https://agenticlakehouse.com/videos/): Short silent explainers on governed agent data access, semantic layers, MCP, Iceberg snapshots, and safe agent writes.

## Pillar Pages

- [What is an Agentic Lakehouse? Definition and Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/what-is-agentic-lakehouse/): What an agentic lakehouse is, how it differs from a traditional data lakehouse, its four architecture layers, and how Apache Iceberg and Dremio power it.
- [Agentic Lakehouse Reference Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/agentic-lakehouse-architecture/): Free agentic lakehouse reference architecture (SVG and PNG, CC BY 4.0): storage, Iceberg, catalog, engine, semantic layer, MCP, agents, and governance.
- [The Future of BI is Agentic](https://agenticlakehouse.com/agentic-bi/): Agentic BI with Dremio: query data where it lives through federation, keep it fast with Reflections, and give AI agents one semantic layer to reason over.
- [Dremio AI Features: An Agentic Lakehouse Example](https://agenticlakehouse.com/dremio-ai/): An example implementation of agentic lakehouse capabilities: the AI features built into Dremio, from SQL AI functions to autonomous performance.
- [Dremio Catalog on Apache Polaris](https://agenticlakehouse.com/dremio-polaris/): An example implementation of the agentic lakehouse catalog layer: Dremio Catalog, built on Apache Polaris, and what it offers for interoperability and governance.

## Implementation Patterns (patterns/)

Step-by-step builds with working Python code (PyIceberg, DuckDB, a YAML semantic model, and the official MCP Python SDK). Companion code: mcp-semantic-lakehouse-demo, Apache-2.0: https://github.com/alexmerced-oss/mcp-semantic-lakehouse-demo

- [Agentic Lakehouse Implementation Patterns with Code](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/): Five implementation patterns for the agentic lakehouse, with working Python: governed views, row and column policies, guardrails, and two MCP servers.
- [Agent-Safe Governed Views](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/agent-safe-governed-views/): Step-by-step pattern for agent-safe governed views over Apache Iceberg tables: raw and governed schemas, PII left out, a locked engine, and tests.
- [Build an MCP Server over an Apache Iceberg Catalog](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/mcp-server-over-iceberg-catalog/): Build an MCP server over an Apache Iceberg catalog with PyIceberg: a local SQL catalog, partitioned tables, DuckDB reads, and metadata cost estimates.
- [Query Guardrails for AI Agents: Allowlists and Cost Caps](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/query-guardrails-for-agents/): Query guardrails for AI agents on lakehouse data: allowlists, row limits, statement timeouts, Iceberg metadata cost caps, session budgets, and audit logs.
- [Row and Column Policies for AI Agents](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/row-and-column-policies-for-agents/): Enforce row and column security for AI agents: roles in a semantic model, row filters in governed views, denied metrics, and tests that try to escape.
- [Expose a Semantic Layer to AI Agents over MCP](https://agenticlakehouse.com/patterns/semantic-layer-over-mcp/): Build an MCP server that exposes a semantic layer to AI agents: tool design, metric definitions as tool descriptions, read-only hints, and tests.

## Knowledge Base (kb/)

- [ABAC for Data](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/abac-data/): Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) in a data lakehouse: fine-grained, policy-driven access decided by user attributes and data sensitivity tags.
- [What is Agentic Analytics? A Technical Guide](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/agentic-analytics/): Agentic Analytics defined: the architecture and implementation that let AI agents use a semantic layer to reason over enterprise lakehouse data on their own.
- [Agentic BI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/agentic-bi/): Discover how Agentic BI moves beyond static dashboards, deploying autonomous agents to analyze and act upon lakehouse data automatically.
- [What is an Agentic Lakehouse? A Technical Overview](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/agentic-lakehouse/): Discover the architecture of the Agentic Lakehouse. Learn how semantic layers and open table formats like Apache Iceberg provide a trusted foundation for AI agents.
- [Agentic RAG](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/agentic-rag/): Explore Agentic RAG and discover how it elevates standard document retrieval into a proactive, reasoning-based data exploration framework.
- [Agentic Workflows in Data Engineering](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/agentic-workflows/): Understand Agentic Workflows: how autonomous AI systems navigate multi-step data engineering challenges using ReAct loops and programmatic tool execution.
- [AI Agent Authorization](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-agent-authorization/): Learn the technical patterns for AI Agent Authorization, ensuring that autonomous data agents only access the data and systems they are permitted to use.
- [AI Agents for Data](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-agents-for-data/): Discover how AI Agents for Data transform enterprise analytics from static dashboards to programmatic, autonomous reasoning systems.
- [AI Chatbots vs Agentic AI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-chatbots-vs-agentic-ai/): The technical differences between AI chatbots and agentic AI systems, and why that distinction decides whether enterprise analytics succeeds or fails.
- [AI Data Governance](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-data-governance/): Discover the principles of AI Data Governance and how automated metadata tagging secures enterprise data for autonomous agent consumption.
- [AI Hallucination in Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-hallucination-in-analytics/): Understand the dangers of AI Hallucinations in structured analytics and how the Agentic Lakehouse architecture mitigates them through Semantic RAG.
- [AI-Powered Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-powered-analytics/): Explore the evolution of AI-Powered Analytics, moving beyond simple SQL copilots to comprehensive, multi-step data reasoning and visualization pipelines.
- [AI Query Engine](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-query-engine/): Understand what makes a modern AI Query Engine and how it differs from traditional SQL databases in the context of the Agentic Lakehouse.
- [What is an AI Semantic Layer?](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ai-semantic-layer/): Learn how an AI Semantic Layer prevents LLM hallucinations by mapping raw data lake schemas to business logic, enabling deterministic agentic analytics.
- [Analytics Engineering](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/analytics-engineering/): Analytics Engineering applies software engineering discipline to data transformation: tested, documented, version-controlled data models built with dbt.
- [Apache Airflow](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-airflow/): Learn how Apache Airflow orchestrates data pipelines in lakehouse environments, coordinating Spark, dbt, and Iceberg maintenance tasks with DAG-based scheduling.
- [Apache Arrow](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-arrow/): Apache Arrow is the in-memory columnar data format that removes serialization overhead between tools and serves as the shared language of the data stack.
- [Apache Flink](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-flink/): Learn how Apache Flink powers real-time streaming data lakehouse architectures by writing exactly-once data into Apache Iceberg tables.
- [Apache Iceberg](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-iceberg/): Apache Iceberg is the open table format that brings ACID transactions, time travel, schema evolution, and hidden partitioning to files in object storage.
- [Apache Kafka Integration](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-kafka-integration/): Learn how Apache Kafka integrates with data lakehouses as the event streaming backbone, enabling real-time data ingestion into Apache Iceberg tables.
- [Apache Polaris](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-polaris/): Learn about Apache Polaris: the open-source, vendor-neutral implementation of the Iceberg REST Catalog API that provides centralized governance for data lakehouses.
- [Apache Spark](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/apache-spark/): Understand Apache Spark's role in the data lakehouse as the dominant batch processing and ETL engine with deep native Apache Iceberg integration.
- [Arrow Flight SQL](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/arrow-flight-sql/): Explore Arrow Flight SQL, the high-performance open protocol replacing JDBC and ODBC for data query transfer, enabling zero-copy columnar data streaming.
- [Automated Data Insights](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/automated-data-insights/): Learn how the Agentic Lakehouse shifts analytics from passive reporting to proactive, automated data insights driven by autonomous AI agents.
- [Automated Data Testing](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/automated-data-testing/): Continuously running data quality tests against Iceberg tables in CI/CD pipelines to catch regressions before they reach downstream consumers.
- [Autonomous BI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/autonomous-bi/): Autonomous BI is the architecture that lets a data platform detect anomalies, investigate root causes, and surface insights without waiting for a human.
- [Autonomous Data Agents](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/autonomous-data-agents/): Dive into the mechanics of Autonomous Data Agents: how they utilize ReAct loops and lakehouse APIs to investigate data anomalies without human supervision.
- [AWS Glue Catalog with Iceberg](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/aws-glue-catalog-iceberg/): Learn how AWS Glue Catalog integrates natively with Apache Iceberg, providing automated table optimization, materialized views, and Lake Formation security.
- [Big Data Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/big-data-analytics/): Big Data Analytics means analyzing datasets too large for traditional tools. Here is how the data lakehouse makes petabyte-scale analytics accessible.
- [Change Data Capture (CDC)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/change-data-capture/): Understand Change Data Capture (CDC), the technique for streaming real-time database changes into Apache Iceberg lakehouses using tools like Debezium.
- [CI/CD for Data](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ci-cd-for-data/): Applying continuous integration and continuous delivery practices to data pipelines and Iceberg lakehouse transformations.
- [Cloud Data Warehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/cloud-data-warehouse/): Understand the Cloud Data Warehouse, its architecture advantages over on-premise systems, and where its limitations emerge in the era of open lakehouse platforms.
- [Cloud-Native Compute](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/cloud-native-compute/): Cloud-native compute in a data lakehouse: elastic, ephemeral clusters replace fixed on-premises servers so analytical processing scales with the work.
- [Cloud-Native Data Warehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/cloud-native-data-warehouse/): Understand the Cloud-Native Data Warehouse: what it is, how Snowflake and BigQuery pioneered the model, and how it compares to the open Data Lakehouse architecture.
- [Column-Level Security](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/column-level-security/): Learn about column-level security in data lakehouses, restricting access to specific columns containing sensitive data without duplicating tables.
- [Columnar Data Formats](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/columnar-data-formats/): Understand columnar data formats like Apache Parquet and ORC, and why they are foundational to achieving high analytical query performance in data lakehouses.
- [Compute-Storage Separation](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/compute-storage-separation/): Understand Compute-Storage Separation: the architectural principle that enables independent scaling of query engines and data storage in the modern Data Lakehouse.
- [Contextual Metadata for AI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/contextual-metadata-for-ai/): Explore the critical role of Contextual Metadata in the Agentic Lakehouse, bridging the gap between raw data physics and AI-driven business logic.
- [Conversational Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/conversational-analytics/): Discover how Conversational Analytics replaces static BI dashboards with stateful, iterative dialogues powered by AI agents within the lakehouse.
- [Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/cost-based-optimizer/): A Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO) uses statistics from Iceberg table metadata to pick the most efficient execution plan for each query in a lakehouse engine.
- [Cross-Cloud Data Sharing](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/cross-cloud-data-sharing/): Sharing Apache Iceberg data across AWS, Azure, and GCP without ETL copies, using the open Iceberg REST Catalog and object storage cross-cloud access.
- [Dagster](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dagster/): Dagster is an orchestration platform built around software-defined assets, giving lakehouse pipelines asset-centric lineage, scheduling, and observability.
- [Data Asset Management](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-asset-management/): Treating Iceberg tables as managed assets with owners, SLAs, documentation, and lifecycle policies in the enterprise data lakehouse.
- [Data Caching Strategies](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-caching-strategies/): Learn the key data caching strategies used in lakehouse architectures, from NVMe local disk caches to distributed memory caches, to maximize query performance.
- [Data Catalog Integration](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-catalog-integration/): Connecting Apache Iceberg lakehouses to data catalog platforms for metadata discovery, search, and governance across the enterprise.
- [Data Cataloging](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-cataloging/): Learn how Data Cataloging gives analysts and AI agents the metadata context needed to find, trust, and correctly use enterprise datasets at scale.
- [The Data Context Layer](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-context-layer/): Explore the Data Context Layer: the central repository of tribal knowledge that empowers AI agents to understand the business intent behind raw lakehouse schemas.
- [Data Contracts](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-contracts/): Data contracts are formal agreements between data producers and consumers that define schema, quality expectations, SLAs, and meaning for lakehouse data.
- [Data Democratization](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-democratization/): Making lakehouse data accessible and understandable to business users without requiring SQL expertise or data engineering support.
- [Data Discovery](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-discovery/): Learn how Data Discovery capabilities help analysts and AI agents find, evaluate, and understand relevant datasets across large enterprise data estates.
- [Data Engine Scaling](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-engine-scaling/): How lakehouse query engines scale: horizontal scale-out, vertical scale-up, and auto-scaling that adds or removes compute as the workload changes.
- [Data Engineering](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-engineering/): Understand the discipline of Data Engineering: the practices, pipelines, and patterns that transform raw data into reliable, queryable assets for analytics and AI.
- [Data Fabric](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-fabric/): Explore the Data Fabric architecture and how it provides active metadata-driven integration across distributed enterprise data systems.
- [Data Fabric for AI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-fabric-for-ai/): Learn how a Data Fabric architecture weaves together disparate enterprise silos to provide a unified foundation for AI agents.
- [Data Governance Framework](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-governance-framework/): A data governance framework covers policies, stewardship, access control, and quality standards, and it is what makes AI analytics trustworthy at scale.
- [Data Knowledge Graph for AI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-knowledge-graph-for-ai/): A data knowledge graph encodes how enterprise entities relate, giving AI agents the context they need to reason across complex, connected data domains.
- [Data Lake Metadata Management](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-lake-metadata-management/): Explore the evolution of Data Lake Metadata Management, from the monolithic Hive Metastore to the decentralized, scalable approach pioneered by Apache Iceberg.
- [Data Lake vs Data Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-lake-vs-data-lakehouse/): Data lake vs data lakehouse: the key differences, and how the lakehouse pattern fixes the reliability and governance failures of the raw data lake.
- [Data Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-lakehouse/): Understand the Data Lakehouse architecture: how it unifies the flexibility of a data lake with the performance and governance of a data warehouse.
- [Data Lineage](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-lineage/): Data lineage records where each dataset came from and how it changed, enabling impact analysis, faster debugging, and trust decisions by AI agents.
- [Data Lineage Tracking](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-lineage-tracking/): Data lineage tracking in Apache Iceberg lakehouses, from snapshot-level audit trails to Iceberg V3 row lineage with _row_id and OpenLineage.
- [Data Masking](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-masking/): Data masking in a lakehouse hides sensitive values in query results, protecting PII and confidential data without blocking analytical workflows.
- [Data Mesh](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-mesh/): Understand the Data Mesh architecture and how it shifts data ownership to domain teams while the lakehouse provides the shared technical infrastructure.
- [Data Modeling Techniques](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-modeling-techniques/): Explore data modeling techniques for modern data lakehouses, comparing dimensional modeling, Data Vault, and wide-table approaches for Iceberg-based analytics.
- [Data Monetization](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-monetization/): Strategies for generating revenue from lakehouse data assets through internal analytics products, external data products, and marketplace-based data commerce.
- [Data Observability](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-observability/): Learn about data observability, the ability to understand the health and reliability of data throughout the lakehouse using metrics, logs, and anomaly detection.
- [Data Orchestration](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-orchestration/): Learn about data orchestration for lakehouses, scheduling and coordinating multi-step data pipelines that ingest, transform, and validate Iceberg tables.
- [Data Provenance](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-provenance/): Tracing the complete origin and transformation history of every dataset in the Iceberg lakehouse for compliance, reproducibility, and trust.
- [Data Quality Framework](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-quality-framework/): Data quality frameworks for Apache Iceberg lakehouses: validation approaches, expectation tests, and monitoring that keep table data clean and reliable.
- [Data Quality Rules](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-quality-rules/): Defining, enforcing, and monitoring specific measurable rules about data values and structures in Apache Iceberg lakehouse tables.
- [Data Vault 2.0](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-vault-2/): Data Vault 2.0 for warehouses and lakehouses: how the hub, link, and satellite model supports audit-complete, agile enterprise data integration.
- [Data Versioning](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-versioning/): Tracking and managing versions of datasets and machine learning training data in Iceberg lakehouses for reproducibility and rollback.
- [Data Virtualization](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-virtualization/): Understand Data Virtualization: creating a unified logical data view across heterogeneous sources at the query layer, without physically moving or replicating data.
- [Data Warehouse vs Data Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/data-warehouse-vs-data-lakehouse/): Compare the Data Warehouse and Data Lakehouse architectures side by side to understand when each is appropriate and why the lakehouse has become the modern default.
- [Databricks Photon Engine](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/databricks-photon-engine/): Databricks Photon is a native C++ vectorized query engine that speeds up Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg workloads on the Databricks platform.
- [Databricks UniForm](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/databricks-uniform/): Discover Databricks UniForm (Universal Format): the interoperability layer that automatically generates Iceberg metadata for native Delta Lake tables.
- [DataFusion](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/datafusion/): Explore Apache DataFusion, the high-performance, embeddable Rust query engine used as a foundation for next-generation data tools and lakehouse engines.
- [DataOps](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dataops/): DataOps applies DevOps principles to data pipelines: automation, testing, monitoring, and short iteration cycles that help data teams ship reliably.
- [dbt (Data Build Tool)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dbt-data-build-tool/): How dbt turns raw Iceberg lakehouse data into analytics-ready Gold tables with SQL models, tests, and documentation in a version-controlled workflow.
- [Delta Universal Format](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/delta-universal-format/): Explore Delta Universal Format, the underlying open-source mechanism within the Delta Lake project that powers interoperability with Apache Iceberg.
- [Distributed Query Processing](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/distributed-query-processing/): Explore distributed query processing, the mechanics of how modern lakehouse engines coordinate thousands of nodes to execute SQL queries against petabyte-scale data.
- [Distributed SQL Query Engine](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/distributed-sql-query-engine/): Understand how Distributed SQL Query Engines coordinate massively parallel query execution across clusters to process petabyte-scale lakehouse datasets.
- [Dremio](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dremio/): Learn about Dremio, the unified, intelligent data lakehouse platform designed to deliver sub-second analytical performance on open data architectures like Iceberg.
- [Dremio Cloud](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dremio-cloud/): Explore Dremio Cloud, the fully managed, SaaS lakehouse platform that eliminates infrastructure overhead while delivering sub-second query performance.
- [Dremio Data Reflections](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dremio-data-reflections/): Explore Dremio Data Reflections, the automated, Iceberg-native query acceleration technology that eliminates the need for manual ETL and data extracts.
- [Dremio Performance](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dremio-performance/): Discover the architectural advantages that enable Dremio's query engine to deliver sub-second performance directly on Apache Iceberg data lakes.
- [Dremio Semantic Layer](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/dremio-semantic-layer/): Understand the Dremio Semantic Layer: the centralized intelligence hub that governs security, unifies data formats, and acts as the brain for AI agents.
- [DuckDB](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/duckdb/): Discover DuckDB, the in-process analytical database that enables fast, serverless querying of Apache Iceberg tables from a single machine or browser.
- [Enterprise AI Agents](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/enterprise-ai-agents/): Discover what separates consumer-grade chatbots from true Enterprise AI Agents capable of autonomous reasoning over governed data lakehouses.
- [Enterprise Data Security](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/enterprise-data-security/): Enterprise data security for lakehouses: encryption, network security, audit logging, and compliance frameworks that protect petabyte-scale data.
- [Ephemeral Compute Clusters](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ephemeral-compute-clusters/): Ephemeral compute clusters are short-lived cloud resources that start on demand, process lakehouse data, and shut down when the job completes.
- [ETL vs ELT](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/etl-vs-elt/): Compare ETL and ELT data integration patterns and understand why ELT has become the standard approach in cloud-native lakehouse architectures.
- [Federated Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/federated-analytics/): Explore federated analytics, the ability to run SQL queries across multiple disparate data sources as if they were a single unified database.
- [Federated Querying](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/federated-querying/): Understand Federated Querying: how a single SQL engine reads across Iceberg tables, operational databases, and SaaS sources in one query without moving data.
- [Regulatory Compliance (GDPR/CCPA)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/gdpr-ccpa-compliance/): How Apache Iceberg lakehouse capabilities address GDPR and CCPA compliance requirements including data deletion, portability, and audit trails.
- [GenAI Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/genai-analytics/): Understand how GenAI Analytics synthesizes structured data into strategic narratives within the Agentic Lakehouse ecosystem.
- [Generative AI Data Stack](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/generative-ai-data-stack/): Map the full Generative AI Data Stack and understand how each layer from storage to orchestration supports autonomous analytics on the Agentic Lakehouse.
- [Governance Policy as Code](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/governance-policy-as-code/): Governance policy as code manages lakehouse access control, data quality rules, and compliance requirements as version-controlled code artifacts.
- [Governed AI Querying](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/governed-ai-querying/): Learn how Governed AI Querying protects enterprise data. Understand why security must be enforced at the lakehouse execution engine, not the LLM level.
- [Headless BI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/headless-bi/): Headless BI separates metric computation from visualization and serves results through APIs to any consumer, including dashboards and AI agents.
- [High Concurrency Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/high-concurrency-analytics/): How lakehouse query engines serve high concurrency analytics: hundreds of simultaneous users without queries interfering or performance degrading.
- [Iceberg ACID Transactions](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-acid-transactions/): How Apache Iceberg provides ACID transactions on the data lake, keeping atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability across many compute engines.
- [Iceberg Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-architecture/): Iceberg architecture explained: the catalog, metadata, and data layers, how snapshots and manifest files work, and why the design performs at scale.
- [Iceberg Branching and Tagging](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-branching-and-tagging/): Explore Iceberg Branching and Tagging: the metadata capabilities that allow data engineers to create isolated testing environments and reproducible data snapshots.
- [Iceberg Catalog](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-catalog/): Learn what the Apache Iceberg Catalog is: the central tracking mechanism that manages pointers to metadata files, enabling ACID transactions and concurrency control.
- [Iceberg Compaction](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-compaction/): Learn about Iceberg Compaction: the critical maintenance process that merges small files, applies deletes, and sorts data to optimize read performance.
- [Iceberg Copy-on-Write](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-copy-on-write/): Understand the Iceberg Copy-on-Write (CoW) strategy: why rewriting entire data files during updates provides the fastest analytical read performance.
- [Iceberg Data Skipping](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-data-skipping/): Iceberg data skipping uses min/max column statistics in table metadata to rule out files a query cannot match, so engines scan far less data.
- [Iceberg Equality Deletes](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-equality-deletes/): Understand Iceberg Equality Deletes: how they enable streaming CDC pipelines by recording deleted rows based on column values rather than physical file paths.
- [Iceberg Hidden Partitioning](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-hidden-partitioning/): Iceberg hidden partitioning derives partition values from columns with transforms, so users filter on normal columns instead of physical partition fields.
- [Iceberg Manifest Files](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-manifest-files/): Iceberg manifest files are Avro metadata files that track individual data files and their column-level statistics, which makes data skipping possible.
- [Iceberg Manifest List](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-manifest-list/): The Iceberg manifest list is the Avro file that indexes a snapshot's manifests, letting engines prune partitions before reading any manifest file.
- [Iceberg Materialized Views](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-materialized-views/): Explore the evolution of Materialized Views in Apache Iceberg, detailing how precomputed query results are managed and accelerated across the lakehouse ecosystem.
- [Iceberg Merge-on-Read](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-merge-on-read/): Explore Iceberg Merge-on-Read (MoR): the Spec v2 feature that optimizes for fast writes and streaming ingestion by using delete files instead of rewriting data.
- [Iceberg Metadata File](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-metadata-file/): Explore the Iceberg Metadata File (JSON): the root of the metadata tree that defines the table's schema, partition specs, properties, and snapshot history.
- [Iceberg Optimistic Concurrency](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-optimistic-concurrency/): Understand Iceberg Optimistic Concurrency: how Iceberg allows multiple engines to write to the same table simultaneously without locking data files.
- [Iceberg Partition Evolution](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-partition-evolution/): Iceberg partition evolution changes a table's partition layout without rewriting old data; engines plan queries across both old and new layouts.
- [Iceberg Position Deletes](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-position-deletes/): Learn about Iceberg Position Deletes: how they track deleted rows by their physical file path and row index, enabling efficient Merge-on-Read processing.
- [Iceberg REST Catalog](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-rest-catalog/): The Iceberg REST Catalog API is the open standard for table metadata access, so different compute engines can share one catalog without vendor lock-in.
- [Iceberg Rollbacks](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-rollbacks/): Learn how Apache Iceberg Rollbacks provide instant data recovery by resetting the table's active state to a previous historical snapshot.
- [Iceberg Row-Level Deletes](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-row-level-deletes/): Explore Iceberg Row-Level Deletes: the core mechanism behind the Merge-on-Read strategy that allows engines to invalidate data without rewriting large files.
- [Iceberg Schema Evolution](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-schema-evolution/): Learn how Iceberg Schema Evolution enables safe, backward-compatible schema changes (add, drop, rename, reorder columns, promote types) without rewriting data files.
- [Iceberg Small File Problem](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-small-file-problem/): Understand the Iceberg Small File Problem: why thousands of tiny data files degrade lakehouse performance and how to solve it through compaction and tuning.
- [Iceberg Snapshots](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-snapshots/): Every Iceberg write creates an immutable snapshot that can be read on its own, which enables time travel, rollback, and safe reads during concurrent writes.
- [Iceberg Table Maintenance](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-table-maintenance/): Learn the three critical operations for Apache Iceberg Table Maintenance: Expiring Snapshots, Removing Orphan Files, and Rewriting Data Files (Compaction).
- [Iceberg Time Travel](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-time-travel/): Iceberg time travel queries a table as of a past snapshot or timestamp with AS OF syntax, for debugging, auditing, and reproducible AI agent answers.
- [Iceberg V2 Spec](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-v2-spec/): Explore the Apache Iceberg V2 Specification: the update that introduced row-level deletes, making the table format suitable for streaming and CDC workloads.
- [Iceberg View Specification](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-view-specification/): The Iceberg View Specification stores SQL view definitions across dialects in a standard format, so views and materialized views work across engines.
- [Iceberg vs Apache Hudi](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-vs-apache-hudi/): Compare Iceberg vs Apache Hudi: architecture differences in metadata, indexing, CDC and streaming upsert capabilities, and which format fits which workload.
- [Iceberg vs Delta Lake](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-vs-delta-lake/): Compare Iceberg vs Delta Lake: architecture differences, engine support, governance models, and when to choose each as your open table format.
- [Iceberg Z-Ordering](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/iceberg-z-ordering/): Learn about Iceberg Z-Ordering: a multi-dimensional sorting technique used during compaction to cluster data and optimize query performance across multiple columns.
- [In-Memory Data Grid](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/in-memory-data-grid/): Learn about In-Memory Data Grids (IMDGs) and how they complement lakehouse architectures for ultra-low-latency data access for operational analytics.
- [The Intelligent Data Foundation](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/intelligent-data-foundation/): Explore the architecture of an Intelligent Data Foundation. Learn why open formats and governed engines are required to safely deploy AI agents.
- [Intelligent Query Planning](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/intelligent-query-planning/): Explore how Intelligent Query Planning allows AI agents to decompose complex business questions into efficient, multi-step execution plans against lakehouse data.
- [Kimball Methodology](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/kimball-methodology/): Understand the Kimball dimensional modeling methodology, its core principles of business process modeling and fact/dimension table design for lakehouse analytics.
- [Lakehouse Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-architecture/): Lakehouse architecture in four layers: object storage, open table formats, catalog, and query engine, and how they fit together as one data platform.
- [Lakehouse Cost Optimization](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-cost-optimization/): Lakehouse cost optimization: storage tiering, file compaction, Dremio Reflections, autoscaling, and query pruning that cut spend without slowing queries.
- [Lakehouse Interoperability](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-interoperability/): Understand Lakehouse Interoperability, the architectural principle that prevents vendor lock-in by standardizing on open formats like Iceberg, Delta, and Parquet.
- [Lakehouse Migration](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-migration/): A practical guide to Lakehouse Migration: phased strategies for moving from on-premise Hadoop or proprietary cloud warehouses to an open Apache Iceberg lakehouse.
- [Lakehouse Performance](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-performance/): Understand the key techniques for achieving sub-second Lakehouse Performance: partition pruning, query reflections, caching, and columnar execution optimization.
- [Lakehouse TCO](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/lakehouse-tco/): Understand Lakehouse TCO (Total Cost of Ownership): how to compare the true all-in costs of a proprietary cloud warehouse vs an open Apache Iceberg lakehouse.
- [LLM Data Access](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/llm-data-access/): Understand the technical mechanics of LLM Data Access, including Arrow Flight SQL, Zero-Copy architecture, and securing data retrieval for AI agents.
- [LLM-driven BI](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/llm-driven-bi/): Explore the mechanics of LLM-driven BI and how Large Language Models act as natural language interfaces for enterprise analytics.
- [Logical Data Warehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/logical-data-warehouse/): A logical data warehouse is a federated architecture that presents one query surface over distributed data sources without moving all the data.
- [Low Latency Queries](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/low-latency-queries/): Understand the techniques and architectural patterns for achieving low latency queries in data lakehouses, from partition pruning to local NVMe caching.
- [Machine Learning Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/machine-learning-lakehouse/): Understand the Machine Learning Lakehouse pattern and how it unifies feature engineering, model training, and inference within a single governed storage tier.
- [Master Data Management (MDM)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/master-data-management/): Understand Master Data Management (MDM) for data lakehouses, ensuring a single authoritative version of core business entities across the enterprise data ecosystem.
- [Materialized Views](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/materialized-views/): Understand materialized views in data lakehouses, pre-computed query results stored as physical Iceberg tables that accelerate repeated analytical workloads.
- [Metadata Management](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/metadata-management/): Governing the technical and business metadata describing Iceberg tables to enable data discovery, quality assessment, and AI-driven analytics.
- [Metric Store](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/metric-store/): A metric store centralizes KPI definitions in version-controlled files so teams and AI agents stop working from conflicting business metrics.
- [Modern Data Stack](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/modern-data-stack/): The Modern Data Stack is the composable, cloud-native toolchain that replaced legacy ETL and on-premises warehouses with specialized SaaS components.
- [MPP (Massively Parallel Processing)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/mpp-massively-parallel-processing/): MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) in a lakehouse: distributed query engines split large analytical workloads across many nodes that run at once.
- [Multi-Cloud Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/multi-cloud-lakehouse/): Explore the Multi-Cloud Lakehouse pattern and how open table formats enable a single governed data platform to span AWS, Azure, and GCP simultaneously.
- [Multi-Engine Data Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/multi-engine-data-architecture/): Explore multi-engine data architecture, where different specialized query engines operate simultaneously on the same open Apache Iceberg data without lock-in.
- [The Multimodal Data Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/multimodal-data-lakehouse/): Understand the architecture of the Multimodal Data Lakehouse and how it unifies structured tabular data with unstructured media for advanced AI workflows.
- [Natural Language Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/natural-language-analytics/): Explore the architectural shift to Natural Language Analytics (NLA), replacing SQL constraints with conversational reasoning within the Agentic Lakehouse.
- [Object Storage for Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/object-storage-for-analytics/): Learn why cloud object storage became the foundational data tier for modern analytics and how it powers the Data Lakehouse at petabyte scale.
- [ODBC/JDBC Drivers](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/odbc-jdbc-drivers/): Learn about ODBC and JDBC drivers for data lakehouses, the connectivity standards that enable BI tools, spreadsheets, and legacy applications to query Iceberg data.
- [Open Data Architecture](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/open-data-architecture/): Open data architecture frees data from proprietary silos by standardizing on open table formats like Apache Iceberg and engines that can all read them.
- [Open Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/open-lakehouse/): Understand the Open Lakehouse concept: a lakehouse built entirely on open standards and open source formats, free from proprietary vendor lock-in.
- [Open Table Formats](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/open-table-formats/): Open table formats explained: why Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Apache Hudi exist, and how they add ACID semantics and versioning to data lake files.
- [Parquet vs Iceberg](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/parquet-vs-iceberg/): Understand the difference between Parquet and Iceberg: why Parquet is an open file format for storage, while Iceberg is an open table format for ACID transactions.
- [PII Data Protection](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/pii-data-protection/): PII protection in a data lakehouse: classification, access controls, masking, and GDPR-compliant deletion built on Apache Iceberg's ACID transactions.
- [Polars](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/polars/): Explore Polars, the lightning-fast Rust-native DataFrame library with native Apache Iceberg read and write support through scan_iceberg and sink_iceberg.
- [Predictive AI Agents](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/predictive-ai-agents/): Learn how Predictive AI Agents combine machine learning scoring with autonomous reasoning to move from reactive reporting to forward-looking enterprise decisions.
- [Prefect](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/prefect/): A modern Python-native workflow orchestration platform for building and monitoring resilient data pipelines in Iceberg lakehouses.
- [Presto](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/presto/): Explore Presto (PrestoDB), the high-concurrency, distributed SQL query engine designed for interactive analytics on open lakehouse architectures.
- [Project Nessie](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/project-nessie/): Learn about Project Nessie: the transactional metadata catalog that brings Git-like branching, merging, and isolation to Apache Iceberg data lakes.
- [PySpark](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/pyspark/): PySpark is the Python API for Apache Spark, used by data engineers and scientists to process large datasets and read and write Iceberg tables in Python.
- [Query Caching](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/query-caching/): Query caching in a data lakehouse, from result caches to columnar file caches, and how each removes repeated work so BI dashboards load quickly.
- [Query Pushdown](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/query-pushdown/): Query pushdown moves filters and projections down to the data source, so a lakehouse query reads and transfers only the rows and columns it needs.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in the Lakehouse](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/rag/): Explore how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) operates within a data lakehouse, moving beyond document search to enable deterministic structured data querying.
- [Ray Data](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/ray-data/): Understand Ray Data, the distributed data processing library that bridges the gap between Apache Iceberg lakehouses and distributed machine learning workloads.
- [RBAC for Data](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/rbac-data/): Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) in a data lakehouse grants permissions to roles and roles to users, giving consistent, auditable data governance.
- [Real-Time AI Decisions](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/real-time-ai-decisions/): Explore how Real-Time AI Decisions are powered by streaming data pipelines and low-latency lakehouse query engines, enabling sub-second autonomous choices.
- [Real-Time Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/real-time-analytics/): Real-time analytics delivers fast answers on continuously arriving data using streaming ingestion, Iceberg streaming writes, and low-latency engines.
- [Row-Level Security](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/row-level-security/): Understand row-level security in data lakehouses, filtering rows at query time so users only see data they are authorized to access based on their attributes.
- [S3 Data Lake](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/s3-data-lake/): Amazon S3 as the base of a data lake and lakehouse: bucket design, access patterns, and how Apache Iceberg turns raw S3 files into governed tables.
- [S3 Object Storage with Iceberg](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/s3-object-storage-iceberg/): Explore how Apache Iceberg is optimized for S3 Object Storage, resolving traditional data lake bottlenecks like directory listing latency and eventual consistency.
- [Safe Action Loops](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/safe-action-loops/): Dive into the mechanics of Safe Action Loops: how Agentic Lakehouses prevent rogue AI behavior through deterministic execution bounds and circuit breakers.
- [Secure Data Sharing](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/secure-data-sharing/): Sharing Apache Iceberg data assets with external partners securely without data duplication, using catalog-level access controls and vended credentials.
- [Self-Service Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/self-service-analytics/): Self-service analytics lets business users explore data and find answers on their own, with governance guardrails that keep it safe as usage grows.
- [Semantic Data Layer](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/semantic-data-layer/): Explore the Semantic Data Layer, the critical architectural component that translates raw database schemas into consistent business logic for AI agents.
- [Semantic Layer](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/semantic-layer/): Learn what a Semantic Layer does, how it encodes business logic above the physical schema, and why it is critical infrastructure for AI-driven analytics.
- [Serverless Data Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/serverless-data-analytics/): Serverless data analytics runs queries on demand with no clusters to manage. Learn where it saves money on ad hoc analysis and where it falls short.
- [Serverless SQL](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/serverless-sql/): Explore serverless SQL in the data lakehouse context, where fully managed, auto-scaling query engines eliminate cluster management and deliver pay-per-query pricing.
- [Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/slowly-changing-dimensions/): Master Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) patterns for Iceberg lakehouses, and how Iceberg's time travel and MERGE make SCD Type 2 implementation cleaner than ever.
- [Snowflake Iceberg Tables](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/snowflake-iceberg-tables/): Learn how Snowflake integrates with Apache Iceberg, detailing the differences between Snowflake-managed and externally managed catalogs and storage configurations.
- [Snowflake Query Engine](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/snowflake-query-engine/): Explore the Snowflake query engine architecture, including its micro-partition model, virtual warehouses, Gen2 runtime, and Snowflake Optima autonomous optimization.
- [Spark SQL](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/spark-sql/): Learn about Spark SQL, the declarative SQL interface within Apache Spark used to query and manage Apache Iceberg tables at scale.
- [SQL Dialects](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/sql-dialects/): Understand SQL dialects and why they matter in lakehouse environments where multiple engines with slightly different SQL syntax operate on the same Iceberg data.
- [Star Schema vs Snowflake Schema](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/star-schema-vs-snowflake-schema/): Star schema vs snowflake schema: how the two dimensional modeling approaches compare, and the trade-offs for Iceberg lakehouses queried with SQL.
- [Streaming Data Pipelines](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/streaming-data-pipelines/): Streaming data pipelines for Apache Iceberg: using Apache Flink and Spark Structured Streaming to land real-time event streams in the lakehouse.
- [Streaming vs Batch Processing](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/streaming-vs-batch-processing/): Compare Streaming vs Batch Processing: understand when each model fits, how Iceberg supports both, and how the Lambda and Kappa architectures address this choice.
- [Sub-Second Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/sub-second-analytics/): Explore sub-second analytics, the combination of architectural techniques enabling modern lakehouse platforms to return analytical query results in under one second.
- [Tabular Iceberg](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/tabular-iceberg/): Learn about Tabular, the company founded by the original creators of Apache Iceberg, and its strategic acquisition by Databricks in 2024 to bridge open formats.
- [Text-to-SQL: Evolution and Limitations](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/text-to-sql/): A technical guide to Text-to-SQL. Understand the evolution from zero-shot LLM prompts to semantic-RAG driven query generation in the enterprise data lakehouse.
- [Trino](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/trino/): Learn about Trino, the highly mature distributed SQL engine with a rich open-source ecosystem and first-class Apache Iceberg support including Iceberg v3.
- [Trusted Data Environments](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/trusted-data-environments/): Creating controlled, auditable research environments that provide regulated access to sensitive Iceberg data for analytics and AI model development.
- [Trustworthy AI Execution](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/trustworthy-ai-execution/): Learn how the Agentic Lakehouse enforces trustworthy AI execution through immutable audit logs, credential delegation, and bounded tool access.
- [Unified Data Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/unified-data-analytics/): Unified data analytics runs BI, data science, ML, and AI workloads on one lakehouse platform, removing the silos between separate specialized tools.
- [Vectorized Query Execution](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/vectorized-query-execution/): Vectorized query execution processes columnar data in batches instead of row by row, which is how modern engines run analytical queries much faster.
- [Zero-ETL](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/zero-etl/): Zero-ETL removes data movement pipelines by giving direct, governed query access across operational systems and the lakehouse where data already lives.
- [Zero-Trust AI Analytics](https://agenticlakehouse.com/kb/zero-trust-ai-analytics/): Learn how Zero-Trust principles applied to AI Analytics enforce continuous verification of every data access request made by autonomous agents.
